title: Edmund and the Atlas
author: Tamsin Blackwood
blurb: Gideon Dravenmoor, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
